observations: Photo 0 shows a grey industrial sewing machine mounted on a white metal table with a foot pedal and exposed wiring.
The machine has a large needle and presser foot assembly, typical of industrial models.
The table surface is worn and stained, with visible rust and grime.
The foot pedal is white with multiple holes, likely for foot control, and appears to be in used condition.
The background shows a blue curtain and a white wall, suggesting an indoor setting.
There is a watermark 'POSTEDON JIJI BOLA BABATIMEHIN' across the image.

claims.claim: Original Brother DB2-B755 industrial sewing machine
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.
The seller's location claim cannot be verified from the photos alone.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the machine in operation, including needle movement, motor sound, and foot pedal response.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged parts (e.g., bobbin case, presser foot, or accessories)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the bobbin area, presser foot, and any included accessories.

risks.risk: Wear and tear affecting performance or safety
risks.proof: Photos of the needle, feed dogs, and internal mechanisms to check for rust, wear, or damage.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation.
Close-up photos of the bobbin area, presser foot, and internal mechanisms.
Photos of any included accessories or parts.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
